nodes.label: ISO/IEC 39075 Information Technology — Database Languages — GQL Standard
nodes.description: International standard specifying GQL, a declarative property graph query language providing pattern matching, property graph schema definitions, and composable graph transformations.

nodes.label: Intel AVX-512 SIMD Vector Instruction Set Architecture
nodes.description: 512-bit SIMD vector instruction extensions supporting high-throughput parallel execution of GraphBLAS matrix operations and dense vector embedding distance calculations.

nodes.label: Cryptographic Merkle-DAG Knowledge Graph Provenance Structure
nodes.description: Directed Acyclic Graph structure where every node state and relation edge is content-addressed and cryptographically linked via cryptographic hashes to ensure tamper-evident audit trails.

nodes.label: LaBSE Language-Agnostic BERT Sentence Embedding Model
nodes.description: Multilingual BERT-based sentence embedding architecture producing cross-lingual dense vector representations in a shared embedding space, supporting bilingual Arabic-English entity alignment.

nodes.label: W3C N-Quads Line-Based RDF Dataset Serialization Syntax
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a line-oriented syntax for encoding quad datasets (subject, predicate, object, graph label) to stream large-scale semantic graphs across distributed pipelines.
